This is the story of a learning designer named Kim.
Every morning Kim drove to work through the fog. Every morning, the fog got there first.
…and that fog is staying with us all week. Drive carefully out there.
In business news: a start-up says its new AI tool can build a complete training course in eleven seconds.
It’s called CourseGen. Companies can expect it any day now.
One analyst called it the end of boring training. Another simply called it the end of training.
Kim switched off the radio. Eleven seconds. Her last course had taken three weeks.
She didn’t think about it again. Not for a while.
Kim parked where she always parked. Eight fifty-two, on the dot.
Kim’s job was simple. When someone in the organisation had a problem, Kim made a course about it.
Press E at the desk to help Kim do the work.
Kim did nothing at all. Someone else would, eventually.
